step1_figure.circuit_type: Clocked Sense Amplifier with SR Latch
step1_figure.description: A clocked sense amplifier that uses input transistors at the sources of the cross-coupled NMOS pair to create an imbalance without static power dissipation. An SR latch is added at the output to hold the decision during the clock's low phase.

pmos_turn_on_voltage.description: The voltage level the drain of M1 or M2 must fall below to turn on the cross-coupled PMOS devices.

source.reference: Text: 'Neither PMOS device will turn on until either M1 or M2's drain moves below VDD - VTHP.'

equation.explanation: The cross-coupled PMOS transistors require a gate-to-source voltage greater than their threshold to turn on. Since their sources are at VDD, the gate (connected to the opposite drain) must drop below VDD - |VTHP|.
equation.assumptions: Assumes standard threshold voltage without significant body effect.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on SKY130 nominal VDD of 1.8V and typical PMOS threshold voltage of ~0.42V.

mb1_drain_max_voltage.description: The maximum potential on the drain of the input transistors MB1/MB2 when the clock is high.

source.reference: Text: 'the maximum value on the drain of MB1/MB2 is VDD - VTHN'

equation.explanation: The NMOS pass transistors (M1/M2 and MS1/MS2) can only pass a maximum voltage of VDD - VTHN to the drains of the input transistors.
equation.assumptions: Assumes the clock and precharge nodes reach full VDD.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Body effect on M1/M2 might increase VTHN, slightly lowering this maximum voltage in practice.

input_common_mode_min.description: Minimum input voltage required for the input transistors to turn on and the circuit to operate properly.

source.reference: Text: 'inputs signals are > VTHN to ensure that the circuit operates properly'

equation.explanation: If the input voltage is below the threshold voltage of the input NMOS transistors (MB1/MB2), they will not turn on, and no discharge path to ground will exist.
equation.assumptions: Assumes source of MB1/MB2 is at 0V.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly corresponds to the typical NMOS threshold voltage in SKY130.

kickback_noise.description: The voltage disturbance on the input nodes caused by the clock switching, coupling through parasitic capacitances.

source.reference: Fig 16.37 and Text: 'The kickback noise is approximately 5 mV.'

equation.explanation: Measured as the peak-to-peak voltage deviation on the input node during the clock transition.
equation.assumptions: Highly dependent on the source impedance driving the input nodes.

sky130_expected.calculation: Depends on Cgd of MB1 and source resistance. With a 10k ohm source, expect a few millivolts.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the textbook's simulated value of ~5mV, though it scales with transistor sizing and source resistance.

sensitivity.description: The minimum voltage difference between the inputs required to reliably switch the output to the correct logic state.

source.reference: Text: 'The sensitivity of this sense amplifier is better than 10 mV.'

equation.explanation: The smallest differential input that overcomes device mismatch and dynamic offsets to produce a full logic swing.
equation.assumptions: Assumes perfectly matched transistors in simulation; real silicon requires higher sensitivity due to mismatch.

sky130_expected.calculation: Simulation without mismatch should resolve < 1mV. Textbook states < 10mV for practical design.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A 10mV differential is applied in the testbench to verify it resolves correctly.

switching_current.description: The peak current drawn from the supply voltage during the evaluation phase (when clock goes high).

source.reference: Fig 16.36 and Text: 'current flows only during the times the clock changes states'

equation.explanation: Dynamic current consumed while the cross-coupled inverters resolve the metastable state and charge/discharge internal nodes.
equation.assumptions: Depends heavily on transistor W/L sizing and VDD.

sky130_expected.calculation: Textbook shows ~150uA for a 1V process. For 1.8V SKY130, it will be higher.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Higher VDD (1.8V vs 1V) and typical 2um widths will result in a few hundred microamps of peak current.

step3_testbench.description: Transient testbench to measure sense amplifier delay, peak switching current, kickback noise, and verify sensitivity with a 10mV differential input.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Sense Amplifier Testbench
.lib ${SKY130_PDK} tt

* Parameters for the DUT
.param W_xm1=2u L_xm1=0.15u
.param W_xm2=2u L_xm2=0.15u
.param W_xm3=2u L_xm3=0.15u
.param W_xm4=2u L_xm4=0.15u
.param W_xm5=2u L_xm5=0.15u
.param W_xm6=2u L_xm6=0.15u
.param W_xm7=2u L_xm7=0.15u
.param W_xm8=2u L_xm8=0.15u
.param W_xm9=2u L_xm9=0.15u
.param W_xm10=2u L_xm10=0.15u
.param W_xm11=2u L_xm11=0.15u
.param W_xm12=2u L_xm12=0.15u

* DUT Netlist
xm1 N003 Inp 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
VDD VDD 0 1.8
xm2 Outm Outp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
xm3 Outp Outm VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
xm5 N002 Outm N004 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm5} l={L_xm5}
xm6 N001 Outp N003 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm6} l={L_xm6}
Vinm Inm 0 500m
xm4 Outm clock VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
xm7 Outp clock VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm7} l={L_xm7}
xm8 Outm clock N001 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}
xm9 Outp clock N002 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm9} l={L_xm9}
xm10 N004 Inm 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm10} l={L_xm10}
X_U1 Outp Q Qi VDD 0 NAND_2
X_U2 Qi Outm Q VDD 0 NAND_2

.subckt NAND_2 A B Out VDD GND
  xm3 out B VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
  xm8 out A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}
  xm11 N001 B GND 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm11} l={L_xm11}
  xm12 out A N001 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm12} l={L_xm12}
.ends NAND_2

* Stimulus
* Clock pulse: 0 to 1.8V, 2ns delay, 100ps edges, 4ns width, 10ns period
Vclock clock 0 PULSE(0 1.8 2n 0.1n 0.1n 4n 10n)

* Input stimulus: 10mV differential to test sensitivity
* Vinm is fixed at 500mV in the netlist.
* We drive Inp with 510mV through a 10k resistor to observe kickback noise.
Vinp_src Inp_src 0 510m
Rinp Inp_src Inp 10k

.tran 10p 20n

.control
run

* 1. Measure delay from clock rising edge to Q output valid
meas tran delay_clk_q trig v(clock) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(Q) val=0.9 rise=1

* 2. Measure peak switching current from VDD
let iddd = -i(VDD)
meas tran peak_current max iddd

* 3. Measure kickback noise on Inp node
meas tran max_inp max v(Inp)
meas tran min_inp min v(Inp)
let kickback = max_inp - min_inp
print kickback

* 4. Measure maximum drain voltage of MB1 (N003)
meas tran max_vd_mb1 max v(N003)
print max_vd_mb1

quit
.endc
